name: Gauge metric
description: The gauge metric with the most data points, one series per service and attributes; set MetricName to pin one

panel.title: Gauge metric
panel.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
  trim(concat(ServiceName, ' ', arrayStringConcat(mapValues(Attributes), ' '))) AS series,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = (
  SELECT MetricName FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY MetricName ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1
) AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
